Augmenting fine-tuning with clinical rule-of-thumb guidance

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates fine-tuning and self-refinement methods for an LLM to predict code stroke activation from retrospective ED notes. It evaluates model architectures/tuning techniques rather than a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
